title: Affine Dual Braid Monoids: Finite Cores, Exceptional Cluster Complexes, and Koszul Resolutions
summary: For every finite-rank crystallographic affine Coxeter system $(W,S)$ and Coxeter element $c$, we construct a minimal linear graded free resolution of the trivial module over $k[M([1,c]_T)]$ supported on a rectified exceptional cluster complex. Hence the affine dual braid monoid algebra is Koszul over every field $k$. The exceptional complex is introduced to recover the principal-fibre topology missing from the direct Reading--Stella labelling.
